fullPassage: Richard Heinberg, an American journalist, argues that in building the renewable energy infrastructure to stop global warming, we are actually involved in one of the greatest change projects in human history. In addition to solar panels and wind turbines, we have to build an alternative transport infrastructure, farming procedures and industrial processes. This transformation cannot happen without fossil fuels. For instance, production of concrete structures and steel elements require amounts of energy that is only possible to produce with fossil energy. Production of solar panels requires scarce and expensive minerals which must be excavated, again requiring the use of fossil fuels. Thus, the harder we push towards a renewable energy system, the faster __________________. This is not only expensive, but also an undermining factor for our efforts to cut global emissions. Heinberg remarks that the cost of building this new energy infrastructure is seldom counted in transition proposals, which tend to focus just on energy supply requirements.

questions.passage: Richard Heinberg, an American journalist, argues that in building the renewable energy infrastructure to stop global warming, we are actually ①<u>involved</u> in one of the greatest change projects in human history. In addition to solar panels and wind turbines, we have to build an alternative transport infrastructure, farming procedures and industrial processes. This transformation cannot happen without fossil fuels. For instance, production of concrete structures and steel elements ②<u>require</u> amounts of energy that is only possible to ③<u>produce</u> with fossil energy. Production of solar panels requires scarce and expensive minerals which must be ④<u>excavated</u>, again requiring the use of fossil fuels. Thus, the harder we push towards a renewable energy system, the faster __________________. This is not only expensive, but also an undermining factor for our efforts to cut global emissions. Heinberg remarks that the cost of building this new energy infrastructure is seldom counted in transition proposals, which tend to focus just on energy supply requirements.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② require → requires: 주어가 production(단수)이므로 단수 동사 필요
det.analysis:
✅ ① involved: be involved in ~에 관여하다 — 수동태 정상
❌ ② require → requires: production of ~ (단수 주어) + requires
✅ ③ produce: to produce with — to부정사 정상
✅ ④ excavated: must be excavated — 수동태 정상
det.tip: 주어-동사 수일치: production(단수) → requires

questions.passage: This transformation cannot happen without fossil fuels. For instance, production of concrete structures and steel elements require amounts of energy ①<u>that</u> is only possible to produce with fossil energy. Production of solar panels requires scarce and expensive minerals ②<u>which</u> must be excavated, again ③<u>required</u> the use of fossil fuels. Thus, the harder we push towards a renewable energy system, the faster __________________. Heinberg remarks that the cost of building this new energy infrastructure is seldom ④<u>counted</u> in transition proposals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ required → requiring: 분사구문이므로 현재분사 필요
det.analysis:
✅ ① that: 관계대명사, 선행사 energy를 수식 — 정상
✅ ② which: 관계대명사, 선행사 minerals를 수식 — 정상
❌ ③ required → requiring: 주절과 동시 동작을 나타내는 분사구문 → 현재분사
✅ ④ counted: is seldom counted — 수동태 정상
det.tip: 분사구문: 주어 동일 + 동시 동작 → ~ing (현재분사)

questions.passage: Richard Heinberg argues that in building the renewable energy infrastructure ①<u>to stop</u> global warming, we are actually involved in one of the greatest change projects in human history. In addition to solar panels and wind turbines, we have to build an alternative transport infrastructure, ②<u>farmed</u> procedures and industrial processes. Thus, the harder we push towards a renewable energy system, the faster __________________. This is not only expensive, but also an undermining factor for our efforts ③<u>to cut</u> global emissions. Heinberg remarks that the cost of building this new energy infrastructure is seldom counted in transition proposals, ④<u>which</u> tend to focus just on energy supply requirements.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② farmed → farming: '농업 절차'를 뜻하므로 현재분사(동명사) farming이 올바름
det.analysis:
✅ ① to stop: 목적을 나타내는 to부정사 — 정상
❌ ② farmed → farming: farming procedures(농업 절차)가 올바른 표현
✅ ③ to cut: 목적의 to부정사 — 정상
✅ ④ which: 관계대명사, 선행사 proposals — 정상
det.tip: farming procedures(농업 절차) — farming은 명사/동명사로 '농업'의 의미

questions.passage: Production of solar panels requires scarce and expensive minerals which must be excavated, again requiring the use of fossil fuels. Thus, ①<u>the harder</u> we push towards a renewable energy system, ②<u>the faster</u> __________________. This is not only expensive, but also an ③<u>undermined</u> factor for our efforts to cut global emissions. Heinberg remarks that the cost of building this new energy infrastructure is seldom counted in transition proposals, which tend to focus just on energy supply ④<u>requirements</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ undermined → undermining: '약화시키는 요인'이므로 능동의 현재분사 필요
det.analysis:
✅ ① the harder: the 비교급 ~ the 비교급 구문 — 정상
✅ ② the faster: the 비교급 상관구문의 후반부 — 정상
❌ ③ undermined → undermining: '약화시키는(능동)' 의미이므로 현재분사 필요
✅ ④ requirements: 명사 '요구 사항' — 정상
det.tip: 현재분사(~ing) = 능동/진행, 과거분사(~ed) = 수동/완료

questions.passage: Production of solar panels requires scarce and expensive minerals which must be excavated, again requiring the use of fossil fuels. Thus, __________. This is not only expensive, but also an undermining factor for our efforts to cut global emissions.
questions.stem:

[the / harder / we / push / towards / a / renewable / energy / system / the / faster]. (11단어) (영어로)
questions.wa: the harder we push towards a renewable energy system the faster
accept: the harder we push towards a renewable energy system the faster

det.korean: 재생에너지 시스템을 향해 밀어붙일수록, 더 빨리 ~한다
det.analysis: the 비교급 ~, the 비교급: ~할수록 더 ~하다 (비교급 상관구문)
det.tip: the + 비교급 + S + V, the + 비교급 + S + V

questions.passage: Richard Heinberg, an American journalist, argues that in building the renewable energy infrastructure to stop global warming, we are actually involved in one of the greatest change projects in human history. In addition to solar panels and wind turbines, we have to build an alternative transport infrastructure, farming procedures and industrial processes. This transformation cannot happen without fossil fuels. For instance, production of concrete structures and steel elements require amounts of energy that is only possible to produce with fossil energy. Production of solar panels requires scarce and expensive minerals which must be excavated, again requiring the use of fossil fuels. Thus, the harder we push towards a renewable energy system, the faster __________________. This is not only expensive, but also an undermining factor for our efforts to cut global emissions. Heinberg remarks that the cost of building this new energy infrastructure is seldom counted in transition proposals, which tend to focus just on energy supply requirements.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 재생에너지 인프라 구축에 화석 연료가 필요하다는 역설
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 재생에너지 전환의 숨겨진 화석 연료 의존성
❌ ① 화석 연료의 환경적 피해 — 주제가 아님
❌ ② 태양광 패널의 기술적 발전 — 기술 발전이 주제가 아님
❌ ④ 에너지 전환의 정치적 장벽 — 정치가 아닌 물리적 한계
det.tip: 글의 핵심: 재생에너지 역설 — 친환경을 위해 화석연료가 필요

ch: 화석 연료 사용이 환경에 미치는 피해
재생에너지 전환에 숨어 있는 화석 연료 의존성
에너지 정책 전환을 가로막는 정치적 장벽

questions.passage: Richard Heinberg, an American journalist, argues that in building the renewable energy infrastructure to stop global warming, we are actually involved in one of the greatest change projects in human history. In addition to solar panels and wind turbines, we have to build an alternative transport infrastructure, farming procedures and industrial processes. This transformation cannot happen without fossil fuels. For instance, production of concrete structures and steel elements require amounts of energy that is only possible to produce with fossil energy. Production of solar panels requires scarce and expensive minerals which must be excavated, again requiring the use of fossil fuels. Thus, the harder we push towards a renewable energy system, the faster __________________. This is not only expensive, but also an undermining factor for our efforts to cut global emissions. Heinberg remarks that the cost of building this new energy infrastructure is seldom counted in transition proposals, which tend to focus just on energy supply requirements.
questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 재생에너지 전환은 화석 연료 의존을 전제로 하며 그 비용은 간과된다
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 재생에너지 전환에는 화석 연료가 필수적이며, 그 숨겨진 비용이 제대로 고려되지 않는다
❌ ① 재생에너지가 유일한 해결책이다 — 오히려 한계를 지적
❌ ② 화석 연료를 완전히 대체할 수 있다 — 반대 주장
❌ ③ 에너지 전환 비용은 항상 정확히 계산된다 — seldom counted라고 함
det.tip: 요지: 재생에너지 역설 + 숨겨진 비용 문제

ch: 화석 연료를 완전히 대체할 기술이 이미 존재한다.
에너지 전환 비용은 항상 정확하게 계산된다.
재생에너지 전환에는 화석 연료가 필수적이며, 그 비용은 제대로 고려되지 않는다.
